title: SING PRAISE
TO THE LORD
end: The Praise Garden — enter His gates with thanksgiving
stock_queries: sunlit forest glades peaceful morning light
misty countryside in soft golden light
golden light over calm river water
peaceful river flowing through green trees
sunbeams breaking through ancient woodland canopy

scenes.a: If that quiet whisper of gratitude has been struggling to find its voice today, stay right here.
Lord God, You have given us breath and life to declare Your goodness.
We come before You with honest hearts, choosing to lift our voices in praise no matter the season.
As Your holy word declares in Psalm one hundred and four, verse thirty-three:
I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
Father, let this song of worship remain upon our lips today.
